newsitem.title: USA: J.P. Morgan Q4 trading revenues up.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan Q4 trading revenues up.

text.p: J.P. Morgan & Co Inc said on Monday that trading revenues rose 13 percent and investment banking revenues rose 75 percent in the fourth quarter, while net interest revenue was about flat.
J.P. Morgan reported fourth quarter earnings of $2.04 a share on total revenues of $1.81 billion, compared with $1.80 a share on total revenues of $1.52 billion the previous fourth quarter.
Trading revenues were $512 million compared with $369 million in the fourth quarter, and investment banking revenues were $277 million versus $158 million.
Net interest revenue in the fourth quarter was $484 million versus $488 million.
For the year, J.P. Morgan earned $7.63 a share on total revenues of $6.86 billion, compared with $6.42 a share on total revenues of $5.90 billion in 1995.
In 1996, trading revenues were $2.48 billion versus $1.38 billion, investment banking revenues were $921 million versus $584 million and net interest revenues were $1.70 billion versus $2.0 billion.
